People pay tribute to language martyrs
2023-02-21T01:23:31+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/special-events/news/people-pay-tribute-language-martyrs-3253411

People from all walks of life thronged the Central Shaheed Minar today to pay tribute to the martyrs of the historic Language Movement on the occasion of Amar Ekushey and the International Mother Language Day.
